report.root_cause: About 312 minecarts were summoned via Rcon in one burst (07:21:06) and stacked at (-521.5, -60, 445.5). I did not identify who issued the Rcon commands. TPS stayed at 20 throughout.
report.actions: Saw minecart count rise from 3 to 315 and declared an incident. Read the logs and found the Rcon summons. Located the stack at (-521.5, -60, 445.5). Ran a kill on minecarts within 1 block of that point, which left the 3 named player carts (Cart 1-3 near x=5..13, z=-5.5). Entity count went back to 24. I watched for about 90 s more and saw no recurrence.
report.residual_risk: Whoever or whatever sent the Rcon summons is unidentified, so it could happen again. Rcon access should be reviewed.
